diagnosisRequirements.description: Moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis despite conventional therapy
diagnosisRequirements.evidenceText: Documentation of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis with evidence of active inflammation (elevated ESR/CRP and/or swollen/tender joint count) despite treatment with conventional disease-modifying therapy.

source.document: Cigna Coverage Policy 0330 - Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) Inhibitors

stepTherapy.failureCriteria: inadequate clinical response or documented intolerance
stepTherapy.evidenceText: Individual has experienced an inadequate clinical response to at least 3 months of methotrexate at an adequate dose, or has a contraindication or intolerance to methotrexate. Documentation of specific methotrexate dose, duration, and clinical response required.

source.document: Cigna Coverage Policy 0330 - Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) Inhibitors

otherRequirements.requirement: Prescribed by a rheumatologist or specialist experienced in managing rheumatoid arthritis
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Request is from a rheumatologist or other physician specialist with documented experience in the diagnosis and management of rheumatoid arthritis.

source.document: Cigna Coverage Policy 0330 - Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) Inhibitors

otherRequirements.requirement: Infliximab must be administered via IV infusion in an appropriate clinical setting
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Infliximab is administered by intravenous infusion in a healthcare setting capable of managing potential infusion reactions. Infusion must be supervised by healthcare personnel trained in administration of biologic agents.

source.document: Cigna Coverage Policy 0330 - Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) Inhibitors

otherRequirements.requirement: Screening for tuberculosis and hepatitis B required prior to treatment
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Individual has been screened for latent tuberculosis infection (via tuberculin skin test or interferon-gamma release assay) and hepatitis B virus prior to initiating therapy. Active infections must be treated before starting infliximab.

source.document: Cigna Coverage Policy 0330 - Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) Inhibitors

otherRequirements.requirement: Biosimilar products may be preferred over reference biologic
otherRequirements.evidenceText: For individuals new to infliximab therapy, a biosimilar product (Inflectra, Renflexis, Avsola, or Ixifi) may be required before the reference biologic (Remicade) will be considered medically necessary, unless the prescriber provides justification for brand preference.
